# Security Policy

`nhsmm-interfaces` is under active development. Security maintenance follows the current default development branch; older snapshots do not have a guaranteed backport policy.

## Supported line

| Code line | Security maintenance |
| --- | --- |
| `dev` | current fixes land here |
| older snapshots | no guaranteed backports |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security-sensitive issues privately through GitHub Security Advisories for `awa-si/nhsmm-interfaces` when available. Do not open a public issue for an unpatched vulnerability.

Include:

- affected commit;
- affected adapter/framework;
- minimal reproduction or triggering conditions;
- expected impact;
- relevant environment details;
- known mitigation, if any.

For vulnerabilities in the NHSMM model/runtime package itself, report them to `awa-si/nhsmm` rather than duplicating them here.

Reports are triaged on a best-effort basis; no response-time SLA is implied.
